_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE trade data. Shaped like the real thing, sourced where we could, but no rate here should be quoted as fact. Vaccines and most human-use pharmaceuticals are duty-free into many markets under the WTO Pharmaceutical Agreement, which is why the vaccine rows are 0 — that direction is real even though the exact figures are ours. See docs/regulatory-basis.md.

rules.basis: WTO Pharma Agreement — duty-free treatment is real; row is illustrative

dwell.basis: illustrative, shaped by World Bank LPI-style benchmarks

notes: Routing through a third country does not by itself change the duty owed on arrival — origin rules follow where the goods were produced, not where the ship called. Transhipment is modelled as time and fees, never as a duty saving.
A bonded warehouse or free-trade-zone hold defers duty rather than avoiding it; the tariff-shock option set uses that to buy time, not to dodge the charge.
